mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic expansion across sectors, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with concurrent HOUST and INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the interaction signal over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months) increases cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1100 thousand units for two consecutive months indicates housing sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 1100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals overheating economy with rising rate expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the interaction signal over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months) indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals expanding manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO growth over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
